title: Depth of a finite module
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $I\subset R$ an ideal and $M$ a finite $R$-module. The *$I$-depth* $\operatorname{depth}_I(M)\in\{0,1,2,\dots,\infty\}$ is defined as follows: if $IM\neq M$, it is the supremum of the lengths $r$ of $M$-regular sequences $f_1,\dots,f_r$ in $I$ [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence] (the empty sequence counting as length $0$); if $IM=M$ (for instance $M=0$), $\operatorname{depth}_I(M)=\infty$. If $(R,\mathfrak m)$ is a local ring, $\operatorname{depth}(M):=\operatorname{depth}_{\mathfrak m}(M)$ is the *depth* of $M$, and the depth of the local ring $R$ is $\operatorname{depth}(R)$.
